messages.author: dec1374180c466bd
messages.subject: Problem with make.capthist in secr 4.4.4
parts:
Hello

I encountered a problem while using make.capthist(), which appears to jumble up the trap and capture locations in the output. I don't think I have encountered this issue previously, but I haven't used make.capthist() in quite a while. 

Code is as follows since I had problems attaching it:

library(secr)
library(spatstat)
# Make traps
nx <- 8
ny <- 8
trapSpacing <- 5000
traps <- make.grid(nx, ny, spacing=trapSpacing,
  detector='proximity')
# Make mask
simMask <- make.mask(traps, buffer=2e4)
A <- area(simMask) / 1e4
bbox <- attr(simMask, "boundingbox")
# Set biological parameters
N <- 20
( D <- N / A )  # animals / ha
# Set detection parameters
g0 <- 0.02
sigma <- 5000
nOcc <- 90
# Simulate capture history
set.seed(2359)
popn <- sim.popn(D=N / area(simMask) * 1e4, core=bbox, 
model2d="poisson", Ndist="fixed")
rownames(popn) <- paste0("ID", sprintf("%02d", 
as.numeric(rownames(popn))))
simCH <- sim.capthist(traps, popn=popn,
detectpar=list(g0=g0, sigma=sigma),
noccasions=nOcc, renumber=FALSE)
# Revert to capture file
simCF <- as.data.frame(simCH)
# Add xy coordinates
simCF$x <- traps$x[match(simCF$TrapID, rownames(traps))]
simCF$y <- traps$y[match(simCF$TrapID, rownames(traps))]
# Capthist with Trap ID 
obsCH_TrapID <- make.capthist(simCF[,1:4], traps)
# Capthist with xy coordinates
obsCH_XY<- make.capthist(simCF[,-4], traps, fmt="XY")
# Plot capture histories
par(mfrow=c(1, 3))
plot(simCH, tracks=TRUE, rad=500)
plot(obsCH_TrapID, tracks=TRUE, rad=500)
plot(obsCH_XY, tracks=TRUE, rad=500)
# Fit models
fit_OG <- secr.fit(simCH, mask=simMask)
fit_TrapID <- secr.fit(obsCH_TrapID, mask=simMask)
fit_XY <- secr.fit(obsCH_XY, mask=simMask)


Thanks for any help or suggestions with this.

Yan Ru

# Set detection parameters

# Simulate capture history

model2d="poisson", Ndist="fixed")
rownames(popn) <- paste0("ID", sprintf("%02d", 
as.numeric(rownames(popn))))
simCH <- sim.capthist(traps, popn=popn,
detectpar=list(g0=g0, sigma=sigma),
noccasions=nOcc, renumber=FALSE)
# Revert to capture file
simCF <- as.data.frame(simCH)
# Capthist with Trap ID
# Capthist with xy coordinates

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Problem with as.data.frame [updated] in secr 4.4.4
parts:
You've found a bug in the 'as.data.frame' method for capthist objects - detectors were mis-assigned to captures owing to a mis-placed parenthesis in the last release (4.4.4). I don't think it has many other effects, if any.
Thanks for reporting this! A corrected version will be submitted to CRAN in the next few days.

It seems you were generally just playing around. I suggest
popn <- sim.popn(Nbuffer = 20, core = traps, buffer = 2e4, Ndist = "fixed")
is simpler than the route you took.

Murray
